author: Sophia
title: 5 new steam games that you can miss
text:
In Steam, dozens of games launched daily, and almost unable to track all the releases to search for hidden diamonds. That is why the PC gamer portal compiled a five options that you may have missed.
Cameraman Management games often provide players to participate in the development of traditional companies, such as supermarkets, amusement parks or development studios. Faceminer is devoted to the management of a biometric data collection company. The game is completely opened on the desktop of the fictional operating system and promotes players in any way to expand the production scale online – as in Cookies Clickker and other projects of the same genre.
© Steam
Repo Repo is a horrific cooperation in the style of a deadly company, focusing on the humor and weirdness of a physical motivation. The fact is that all the objects that players need to find are unpredictable by physicists and behavior – the game is not strange with the comedy film in the spirit of people. The project will maintain the early approach of Steam 6-12 months.
© Steam
Fader Meanwhile, the offender: 6DOF shooting game (six degrees of freedom) nostalgic, inspired by Descent's hit, has come from the early approach. Players as a pilot of space destroyer will have to rob giant settings outside the space: from industrial factories to orbit temples. The levels are created according to the procedure, but the game itself is not Roguelite and it can be held in the cooperation mode for four players.
© Steam
Omega 6 star triangle Omega 6 – Suddenly, the adaptation of the manga was written by Takai Imamura. Former artist Nintendo, who works on Star Fox, The Legend of Zelda, F-Zero and other games. The game is an adventure in the spirit of 16-bit missions with light role-playing game elements: in the center of the plot-process of the two pilots is looking for a new home for humanity.
© Steam
Cleaner street 3 A gift for streets of Rage, Ninja Gaienen and other 8 -bit schoolmates: Hardcore 8 -bit about a hero who declared a war with robbers and street thugs. And fans of Synthwave music genre will receive a double gift, because Street Cleaner 3 – a project based on music of the same electronic manufacturer.
© Steam
